name: Excellia Arkadius
original_name: エクセリア・アルカディウス
source:
A female commander who always stands in the vanguard on the battlefield and annihilates her enemies.
Although she wears a dignified air that is difficult to get close to, her appearance as if she were a sculpture is exactly suitable for the name of "Senki".

But this time, she falls into a dastardly trap set by Elizabeth, and she is forced into captivity without even being allowed to resist.
